title: This Electric Car Fakes 8 Gears On Purpose. Here's Why #shorts

scenes.text: This electric car has one gear. So why does it shift eight times?
Hyundai's Ioniq 5 N has about six hundred horsepower. Pull a paddle, and software cuts the power for a moment, faking the jolt of an eight-speed gearbox.
Forget to shift, and it fakes the rev limiter. Ten speakers fake the engine sound.
Dodge's electric Charger has a sound box at the back. Up to one hundred twenty-six decibels, as loud as a Hellcat.
Why? Hyundai says many electric cars give drivers almost no feedback. Now Hyundai is bringing fake shifts to more models.
You can switch it off. So, fun or fake? Tell me below. Follow EV Drive.
